definitions.gloss: completion ceremony; closing ceremony for an academic term
definitions.explanation: A ceremony held at the end of a school term or training program to mark the completion of a course of study. In Japanese schools, typically held at the end of the school year in March for students who are not graduating.

examples.japanese: {修了式|しゅうりょうしき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三月|さんがつ}→三月：00665_sangatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The completion ceremony is held in March.

examples.japanese: {修了式|しゅうりょうしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{校長先生|こうちょうせんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: We listened to the principal's speech at the completion ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{修了式|しゅうりょうしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{修了証書|しゅうりょうしょうしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{授与|じゅよ}→授与：12900_juyo⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At the training completion ceremony, certificates of completion were awarded to everyone.

notes:
USAGE:
Composed of ⟦{修了|しゅうりょう}→修了：11655_shuuryou⟧ (completion of a course) + {式|しき} (ceremony). Distinguished from ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧ (graduation ceremony): {修了式|しゅうりょうしき} marks the end of a term for continuing students, while ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧ marks the final graduation from a school. Also used for training programs, workshops, and courses.

KEY DISTINCTION:
- {修了式|しゅうりょうしき}: end-of-term ceremony (students continue next year)
- ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧: graduation ceremony (students leave the school)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{修了|しゅうりょう}→修了：11655_shuuryou⟧: completion (of a course)
- {修了証書|しゅうりょうしょうしょ}: certificate of completion
- ⟦{始業式|しぎょうしき}→始業式：08555_shigyoushiki⟧: opening ceremony (start of term)
